# Crystal Beats

> Mrugesh Shukla (Crystal Beats) is a professional live musician, Tabla Visharad (distinction), and Music Teacher based in Nadiad, Gujarat, India. Since 2007 he has led a full live band and orchestra for weddings, destination weddings, Garba nights, Bhakti Sangeet, corporate events, and celebrity shows, and teaches Tabla, Octapad, Keyboard, and Congo at Crystal Beats Music Academy.

## About

- Band leader of Crystal Beats, a live band and orchestra offering Tabla, Sitar, Keyboard, Harmonium, Octapad, Flute, Guitar, Dhol, and Drums.
- Founder of Crystal Beats Music Academy, an examination centre recognised by the Gujarat state government, teaching Tabla, Octapad, Keyboard, and Congo one-on-one and in groups.
- 18+ years of live performance and teaching experience since 2007.

## Services

- Ring Ceremony
- Destination Weddings
- Garba Nights
- Reception
- Live Instrumental
- Vedic Event
- Celebrity Events
- Birthday Celebration
- Mehndi / Haldi
- Bhakti Sangeet
- Sangeet Sandhya
- Corporate Events

## Blog

The website includes a blog at /blog with practical guides covering every service and instrument offered — event planning (Ring Ceremony, Reception, Vedic ceremonies, Celebrity and VIP events, Milestone birthdays, Destination weddings), instruments (Tabla, Sitar, Harmonium, Keyboard, Bansuri/Flute, Octapad, Electric Guitar, Dhol, Drums, Congo), practical buyer guides (pricing, booking timelines, live band vs orchestra, sound system quality, devotional music terminology, music academy vs private tutoring, and city-by-city coverage across Gujarat), and local music-academy guidance for Nadiad and Anand — written by the Crystal Beats team in partnership with Rivavya Create and Trade LLP (https://www.rivavya.com).
